newsitem.title: USA: Premier Concepts says to offer $3.75/shr.
newsitem.headline: Premier Concepts says to offer $3.75/shr.

text.p: Premier Concepts Inc said Wednesday the Securities and Exchange Commission has declared effective its registration statement for a secondary public offering.
The company said the offering consists of 1.1 million shares of common stock and 1.1 million class A warrants.
The company said the securites are being offered to the public for $3.75 per share of common stock and $0.15 per warrant.
The company said the offering is being undertaken through several underwriters, of which Cohig & Associates Inc is serving as representative.
